svg.title: A personal digital twin across visits
svg.desc: Three research visits each show synthetic recorded signals, a coupling matrix and a versioned LPM. A trajectory beneath them compares the same person across visits against a dashed reference. Inspired by the signals-to-features-to-state presentation in Integrated-AI; all geometry and data are original and synthetic.

g.text: A personal digital twin across visits
SYNTHETIC RESEARCH ILLUSTRATION / NOT MEASURED DATA
